jobs.occupation: Early Childhood Educator at Kindergarten (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Phorms Education currently runs five bilingual, German-English nurseries within Heilbronn and the surrounding area as part of a cooperation with the Schwarz Group. Another daycare center will open in Bad Friedrichshall at the beginning of 2026. We care for children between the ages of 0 and 6 years in an open and partially immersive concept. Our facilities offer well-equipped functional rooms and outdoor play areas. The pedagogical focus is on bilingualism, music and STEM - the children always remain at the centre of our needs-oriented work and are involved in the day-to-day life of the nursery.

The company nurseries are part of the Phorms Education SE network of bilingual schools and nurseries, that has been enriching the educational landscape in Germany since 2006.

For our nurseries in Heilbronn/Erlenbach/Weinsberg/Bad Friedrichshall we are looking for a motivated and qualified

Early Childhood Educator

(in part-time or full-time)

Our Benefits

- An attractive salary with additional benefits (e.g. company pension scheme, monthly public transport ticket and free, freshly prepared lunch that changes daily)
- A relocation allowance and all paperwork completed and prepared for residency and work permits
- Continuing professional development opportunities
- Open concept with individual support for each child
- Innovative educational concepts and state of the art educational resources
- Short-term provision of employee housing at current market prices for a relaxed arrival

Your Responsibilities  

- Holistic support of our children in the cognitive, emotional, and creative areas
- Preparation and follow-up as well as implementation of parent meetings
- Regular observation of the holistic development and abilities of kindergarten children

Your Profile

- Certified training as an early childhood educator, a degree in education or comparable education that enables you to work as a specialist or supplementary staff member by the respective local authorities
- Identify with our pedagogical concept and are motivated to creatively implement it collaboratively as a team
- Motivated to co-create new pedagogical methodologies to continuously develop with the organisation
- Interest in working in a bilingual and international atmosphere
- Motivated and committed to working as part of a team
- Fluent English skills and German language skills at least level B2

Interested in re-shaping education? Bring your new ideas to life with us and apply now via our website (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/jobs/job/early-childhood-educator/?utm_source=afa&utm_medium=jobanzweb&utm_campaign=BaW%C3%BC_KiTa_Early_Childhood_Educator_engl_0521) .

Please visit jobs.phorms.de (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/overview/)  for more details and do not hesitate to contact Carolin and Lisa, via careers@phorms.de (https://mailto:careers@phorms.de) .

We look forward to your application!

- Experience with Keysight ADS

What we offer

- Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
- A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
- Flexible working hours
- Mental well-being support
- Employee discounts on our products
- Corporate discounts on a variety of brands

We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEERC System develops uncrewed aircraft for certified operation, in a regulatory landscape that is still being written. This role is our presence in the standardisation bodies and industry associations where that landscape takes shape — EUROCAE, GAMA, UAVDACH and BDLI among them — in the working groups drafting the certification specifications, AMC, MOC and supporting standards our aircraft will be measured against. You bring our position into those rooms while the text is still open, and you bring back what it means for us. Inside the company you turn the evolving framework into the certification basis our programmes build against, take part in the exchange with the certification authorities, and support the airworthiness team on compliance work.
WHAT YOU WILL DO● Represent ERC in the associations and standardisation bodies shaping UAS certification standards ● Work inside the drafting groups: comment on drafts, defend positions and follow them through the process ● Track rulemaking and standardisation, and assess early what they mean for our approval route ● Build ERC positions on draft material with engineering, and turn them into written contributions ● Derive and maintain the certification basis for our programmes ● Take part in the exchange with the certification authorities and prepare the input that goes with it ● Support airworthiness on means of compliance and evidence, and flag external changes early

WHAT YOU BRING● Deep, hands-on experience in aviation certification, gained in aircraft or UAS programmes ● Command of the European UAS regulatory system and the derivation of a certification basis ● Experience working in industry associations, standardisation bodies or rulemaking groups ● Comfort in committee settings, where influence comes from preparation rather than authority ● Enough engineering depth to support means of compliance, not only the regulatory argument ● A technical degree in aerospace engineering or a comparable field ● Fluent English, and German at working proficiency for committee and authority work Moreover, it would be helpful if you also ● have worked in an SC Light-UAS or Design Verification Report context ● bring EASA Compliance Verification Engineer experience ● know the military side too, such as STANAG 4671 ● bring an existing network in the European UAS standardisation and association landscape ● bring experience with ARP4754B and ARP4761A

WHAT WEC OFFER● Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides ● A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn ● Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution ● Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation ● Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen ● Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

You'll join a team developing the future of enterprise data transformation. Design and build production-grade, high-volume data processing applications that move billions of records with precision and speed. This role puts you at the intersection of scalability challenges and elegant solutions—where every optimization matters and performance isn't just a feature, it's the foundation.

Beyond building, you'll ensure system reliability. When production issues surface, you'll conduct incident analysis and design stability improvements that strengthen our platform. You'll own the problems that matter to the world's largest enterprises.

What You'll Bring:

You have strong software development and analytical skills and hands-on experience building and operating cloud-based business solutions.

Further requirements are:

- 
Take responsibility for end-to-end quality – from development and testing through production support. You drive solutions!

- 
Eagerness to learn and explore new topics.

- 
Ability to work independently.

- 
Goal-oriented team player with good communication skills.

- 
A solid understanding cloud-based software development and CI/CD practices.

- 
Profound development skills in ABAP OO or another objected-oriented programming language

- 
Experience with AI supported development.

- 
Excellent communication skills in English or German language

Meet Your Team:

You will work on development topics end-to-end while collaborating closely with your colleagues in an agile Scrum team. We value direct communication, shared accountability, and continuous improvement. You will participate in code reviews, share technical knowledge, and help build team capabilities—all while deepening your expertise in ABAP, AI-supported software development, and agentic engineering.
